To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the random phase approximation can be formulated in the number projected quasiparticles mean field, that the number projection can be performed analytically and that the number conserving random-phase-approximation is recovered.

a number-conserving random phase approach can be derived as a special limit of the symmetry-projected quasiparticle random phase approach, all the occurring integrals in this limit can be performed analytically, and the well-known pairing vibrational matrix elements are recovered in the limit of a very large number of particles.

the random phase approximation in symmetry projected quasihole mean fields can be solved analytically in the number conserving case and the resulting equations can also be used to solve the pairing problem in the variational approach.
